# action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Rotates the swarm join tokens, like `docker swarm join-token --rotate`. Nodes already in the swarm are not affected; the old token stops working for new joins. The provider's host must be a swarm manager. Read the new tokens with the `docker_swarm_tokens` data source; they are never printed.

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_swarm_rotate_tokens" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `manager` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Rotate the manager join token. Default `false`. |
| `worker` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Rotate the worker join token. Default `true`. |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_swarm_init" "this" {
  advertise_addr = "eth0"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens.all]
    }
  }
}

# Rotates the join tokens; nodes already joined are unaffected. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_swarm_rotate_tokens.all
action "docker_swarm_rotate_tokens" "all" {
  config {
    worker  = true
    manager = true
  }
}
```
